description: This file defines the AverageAnglePanel class, which is a Swing UI component managing a panel with a reset button and a text area. It listens to sensor data updates via SensorSnifferCentral and displays ASCII report generated by AverageAngles.

classes.name: AverageAnglePanel
classes.description: A Swing UI component that displays average angles calculated from sensor data, with functionality to reset data and display reports.

methods.name: AverageAnglePanel
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the panel UI, including a reset button and a listener for sensor updates.

methods.name: showResults
methods.description: Updates the text area with the latest report from AverageAngles.
